summary: Protobuf unknown-oneof data needs explicit required capability incompatibility
details: Actual native generated decode/consumer tests at 9898c70614a8555efa63d3cec47ba9adbc395bbb show an unknown-only oneof yields no known payload and rejects. Unknown fields alongside a known payload are skipped by prost; an old consumer cannot infer that a future field was a new required oneof alternative.
